data.name: Leg Press Cum Pendulum

colours.name: Play Orange
alts: Leg Press Cum Pendulum outdoor gym combo with leg press and pendulum swing step

data.description: The Leg Press Cum Pendulum joins two leg machines on one frame. The leg press is seated: the user pushes the footplates away and draws them back. The pendulum is standing: the user holds the handles and swings both legs together from side to side, which loosens the hips and waist. Together they give a lower-body routine that suits walkers, office staff and older residents. It comes in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range for parks and societies. Its footprint has not been listed yet. Our standard warranty terms would cover the galvanised pipes on the Leg Press Cum Pendulum for 3 years and bearings for 1 year, and we will confirm this in writing. Ask us for a quote.

The pendulum is standing: the user holds the handles and swings both legs together from side to side, which loosens the hips and waist. Together they give a lower-body routine that suits walkers, office staff and older residents. It comes in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range for parks and societies. Its footprint has not been listed yet. Our standard warranty terms would cover the galvanised pipes on the Leg Press Cum Pendulum for 3 years and bearings for 1 year, and we will confirm this in writing. Ask us for a quote.

Both stations move on bearings: the leg press arm and the pendulum step. Check and grease them at each service, and listen for knocking. The frame is installed self-standing or grouted. Leave room at the sides of the pendulum, because the step swings outward.
